metaDescription: Sloughi vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Sloughi boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Sloughi social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Sloughi exposure.
Weight range 35-50 lb (16-23 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat.) belong in the same Sloughi household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Sloughi is also monitored for sensitivity notes, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Sloughi appointments.
After the Sloughi puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Sloughi boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Sloughi row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Sloughi item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Sloughi kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Sloughi due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Sloughi core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Sloughi misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Sloughi health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Sloughi adult health guide for breed predispositions such as progressive retinal atrophy (pra), then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
